dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}? Paimon? Well, I sure didn't expect to see you here!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Considering your skills, you must be here on some crazy commission. Something to do with that Spiritway over there, maybe?

choices.text: Our present commission is pretty awesome, yes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of which, the person who commissioned us is also from the Children of Echoes. Maybe you know each other...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You describe your encounter with "Dopey Dazzler," her views on graffiti, and her invitation for you to study avant-garde thought...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Ah, the Dopey Dazzler. You could call us friends, hehe...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: She doesn't look like a big deal, quite like me, in fact. But if you get her talking, she can go on forever... If you hang out with her a bit more, you might see a... different side to Natlan, I guess?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did you become friends after she invited you to draw graffiti with her as well?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Graffiti's one of the reasons we're friends... But I guess it's better to say that it was a happy coincidence?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: That was a long time ago. I was buying fruit at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame with my parents, and there she was, sitting at the paint shop entrance, watching as Acat blended paints.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: She would sit there for half a day, almost, not moving a muscle, as though she could see something special in all those different colors.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: She was so focused at that moment. It was like she couldn't care less about anything except the paints! And so I thought she wouldn't notice me—

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Only for her to notice the color of my clothes as I passed, then start chatting with me about our favorite colors. It was like she'd become a different person!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, your clothes are pretty unique! Seems like the Dopey Dazzler's got a good eye for this kind of thing.

choices.text: A fine balance between vitality, simplicity, and innocence.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, that's right! Why didn't Paimon think about that... But yeah, you look just right!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But now you mention it, it sounds like the old Dopey Dazzler was quite different from the person we met. Guess she was... less good at making friends back then?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: She might just have been like I was, kinda bad at dealing with people. I mean, everyone's busy training for battle or practicing their dancing...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: By contrast, someone who focuses on painting might find it hard to make friends...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Still, I find people who have their own goals and work hard at them super cool!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: As I watched her study colors and graffiti so intently, I had the feeling... that she'd stick to her goal and follow it to the end — not all that different from a hero of legend, really!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Perhaps the lack of recognition from others means that the more serious she gets, the better she'll be in the future?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... kind of? Maybe?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: After I met Dopey Dazzler, she invited me to do graffiti together with her, but... Don't get me wrong, I love those pretty patterns. I just don't think I have the talent to come up with anything interesting.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: She said it was alright, though. Said that her graffiti would record our tribe's famous warriors, and that if I couldn't draw anything good, I could at least become a good drawing.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: "And when the time comes, let me, a graffiti artist famed across Natlan, be the one to draw a picture of Kachina, the famous warrior..."

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: And boy, did she look dazzling when she was talking about that!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I'd sometimes serve as her audience when she worked on her graffiti. I gave her all the ideas I could. Like... I'd tell her about all the amazing things I've seen while riding Turbo Twirly up on the clifftops.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I haven't really hung out with her that many times, but just seeing her so hard at works make me want to work harder too.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I've heard that she received inspiration from someone, and has become more talkative as a result, even joining some sort of... grand graffiti gang a few years back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! The Dopey Dazzler's become a real big shot in the Graffiti Alliance, while you've become a hero here in Natlan!

choices.text: Moving up in life, you two!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Thank you... Uh, no, stop looking at me. I'm not going to cry! I'm just... getting a bit emotional...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I'm just glad to know that the Dopey Dazzler's been working hard in her own field... Must have been a tough road for her...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I suppose I could call myself a qualified warrior nowadays... But I'm not sure "famous" is a fitting description...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Ah, I'd love to have a chat with her the next time we meet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right. We're all gonna do our best!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Yup, that's right! I'll keep forging ahead. And if you don't mind... Could I continue studying under you once you finish your work with the Dopey Dazzler?

choices.text: The promise you made will come true for sure.
Almost like the colors of some delicious food.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, like... coffee lemon cake with mint... Ugh, this analogy's making Paimon hungry.

choices.text: Our task is a bit abstract, but it's interesting all the same.
